commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
90+1' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+1' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Cesare Casadei (Torino) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 2:1.
87' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is about to take a corner kick.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rasmus Hojlund leaves the pitch and Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) comes on.
84' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Matteo Politano is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).

82' Matteo Politano (Napoli) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Alberto Paleari to dive and make a save. The referee points to the corner flag and Napoli will take a corner.
82' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
80' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner.
79' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Alisson Santos and he is replaced by Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli).
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Faustino Anjorin (Torino) for Matteo Prati.
75' Che Adams (Torino) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
69' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) replaces Leonardo Spinazzola.
68' 2 - 0 Goal! Eljif Elmas (Napoli) takes a short pass from Matteo Politano in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
67' Substitution. Gvidas Gineitis makes way for Cesare Casadei (Torino).
67' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Giovanni Simeone will be replaced by Sandro Kulenovic (Torino).
66' Alisson Santos (Napoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

66' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. Napoli win a corner.
64' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Michael Fabbri pulls out a yellow card.
63' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
60' Alisson Santos (Napoli) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Alberto Paleari.
60' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
58' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
57' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marcus Pedersen (Torino) replacing Rafael Obrador.
57' Substitution. Duvan Zapata did his best and is replaced by Che Adams (Torino).
56' Alisson Santos (Napoli) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
55' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Duvan Zapata (Torino) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Alisson Santos (Napoli) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

53' A pass into the box finds Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alberto Paleari denies him. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
51' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) fails to beat a perfect example of the offside trap.
49' Alisson Santos (Napoli) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Alberto Paleari.
46' Alisson Santos (Napoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
46' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' Antonio Vergara will be replaced by Frank Anguissa (Napoli).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Michael Fabbri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Napoli keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
42' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
40' Michael Fabbri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mathias Olivera (Napoli).
36' Michael Fabbri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Enzo Ebosse (Torino) and blew his whistle.
35' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli), whose header floated just over the bar.
34' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alisson Santos (Napoli) takes it short.
31' Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
25' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
21' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) commits a foul and Michael Fabbri immediately signals a free kick.
21' Matteo Politano (Napoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

21' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Napoli will have a corner.
20' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alisson Santos (Napoli).
20' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.

17' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Nikola Vlasic (Torino) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.
17' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Napoli).
16' Duvan Zapata (Torino) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
13' Napoli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
11' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Alisson Santos (Napoli) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
7' Matteo Politano (Napoli) works the corner short.
7' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
6' Alisson Santos (Napoli) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
5' Matteo Politano (Napoli) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Alberto Paleari is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
3' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Duvan Zapata, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
2' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Billy Gilmour (Napoli) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Torino will kick the game off.
Michael Fabbri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
